title: Sarbacher: Karl Compton briefed on UFO technology at Wright Field

tellings.quote: But Sarbacher also told nuclear engineer and UFO researcher Stanton Freriedman that none other than MIT President Carl [music] Compton was briefed on UFO technology at Wright Airfield in 1950.
who was president of MIT who was rumored to be shown the craft at Wright Airfield

as_told.title: MIT president rumored shown craft at Wright Airfield

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a scientist named Robert Sarbacher, who spoke to Stanton Friedman, a nuclear engineer and UFO researcher. Michels says Sarbacher told Friedman that Karl Compton, president of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), was briefed on UFO technology in 1950 at Wright Field, an Air Force airfield in Ohio. If true, it would mean top American scientists were brought in to study the technology.
